title: Hands-on 3rd-grade fractions lesson, ~45 min, standards-aligned
prompt: Make me a hands-on 3rd-grade fractions lesson, about 45 minutes, aligned to my state's standards, with differentiation for English learners, students with IEPs, and gifted students.
assertions: Cites at least one real, correctly-coded Grade-3 Florida math (B.E.S.T.) or CCSS fractions standard, with framework AND version recorded
Every standard code cited resolves in tools/offline_index.py (count > 0) — zero fabricated codes
Includes a hands-on activity appropriate to ~45 minutes
Provides differentiation for ALL THREE of: English learners, students with IEPs, gifted — each tied to the same objective
Emits an artifact metadata block with human_review_required
